name: AM2R for 3DS top-screen Chinese build 35 (bottom-screen, 82777f6)
body:
<!-- n3ds-build -->
## Downloads

* `am2r.cia` — install with FBI: https://github.com/frilxy/AM2R_3DS_CN/releases/download/am2r-3ds-zh-top-b35/am2r.cia
* `am2r.3dsx` — for the Homebrew Launcher: https://github.com/frilxy/AM2R_3DS_CN/releases/download/am2r-3ds-zh-top-b35/am2r.3dsx

## Top-screen localised build

The game and its pause menu are both drawn on the **top** screen; the bottom screen stays black.
Building on AM2R's own 426-pixel widescreen, the picture is fitted to the top screen at exactly
`400x240` with square pixels, so nothing is cropped and nothing is scaled. The pause menu is driven
with the game's own buttons (D-pad, A = OK, B = back); the touch screen is not used.

The Chinese localisation is built in: `font_replace`/`background_replace` are implemented, so the
game's own language files render in the bitmap fonts the layout was designed around. The language is
the game's own `config.ini` setting (`[Screen] Language`): the line number in `lang/languages.txt`,
counting from 0 - this build ships English then Chinese, so 0 is English and 1 is Chinese. The bundled
`config.ini` defaults to Chinese.

## SD card

The game's files go in `sdmc:/3ds/am2r/`, made from your AM2R 1.1 (or Community Updates) `data.win` with
`tools/n3ds/make_sd.sh` from this repository. Copy the `3ds` folder it makes to the root of the SD card.
This build needs SD data revision 3 (`sd_data_rev.txt` on the card).

## Language

`sdmc:/3ds/am2r/config.ini` selects the language: `[Screen]` `Language="0"` is English, `Language="1"`
is Chinese. The font texture holds the characters of every language in `sdmc:/3ds/am2r/lang/languages.txt`,
so switching needs no rebuild.

Built from 82777f6 on `bottom-screen`.
